STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_08171_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_08171_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_08171 (
    address,
    chipselect,
    clk,
    reset_n,
    write_n,
    writedata,
    out_port,
    readdata
);

  output [9:0] out_port;
  output [31:0] readdata;
  input [1:0] address;
  input chipselect;
  input clk;
  input reset_n;
  input write_n;
  input [31:0] writedata;

  reg [9:0] data_out;
  wire [9:0] read_mux_out;

  assign read_mux_out = (address == 0) ? data_out : 10'b0;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (!reset_n)
      data_out <= 10'b0;
    else if (chipselect && !write_n && (address == 0))
      data_out <= writedata[9:0];
  end

  assign readdata = {22'b0, read_mux_out}; 
  assign out_port = data_out;

endmodule
